argv: for f in /schemas/*.schema.json; do b=$(basename "$f" .schema.json); for variant in as-is without-dialect-key; do if [ "$variant" = as-is ]; then cp "$f" /tmp/s.json; else grep -v '"[$]schema"' "$f" > /tmp/s.json; fi; out=$(timeout 20 /usr/local/bin/claude -p --no-session-persistence --output-format json --json-schema "$(cat /tmp/s.json)" 'say hello' 2>&1 | head -c 260 | tr '\n' ' '); echo "$b | $variant | $out"; done; done
